title: Stannum
description: Creates a client-side ambient effect using customizable particles, radius, and count
body:
# Stannum

**Stannum** creates particles within a specified radius that are visible only to the player.

![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb9e0cea8567a750aa9d7dd396a9186b049ef0a3_0.webp)

## Usage

### Start

```
/stannum start
```

### Stop

```
/stannum stop
```

### Edit

```
/stannum edit <particle> <count> <radius>
```

`<particle>` - particle type   
`<count>` - number of particles   
`<radius>` - particle area radius   

## Configuration

### config.yml

```yaml
running: false
particle: SOUL_FIRE_FLAME
count: 100
radius: 10
```
